newsitem.title: USA: JJ Kenny's Bowe departs for arbitrage partnership.
newsitem.headline: JJ Kenny's Bowe departs for arbitrage partnership.

text.p: Michael Bowe, who ran JJ Kenny Drake's dollar bond desk, has left to form a municipal arbitrage partnership with Greenwich-based investment adviser Berkley Dean and Co, said James Shiel, president of Berkley Dean.

Berkley Dean is the wholly-owned investment adviser to W.R. Berkley, a property and casualty holding company. It primarily manages in-house money. The new partnership will be called Pocantico Partners. Bowe will be joined by Paul Constantino, formerly of First Chicago Capital Markets.
Shiel declined to provide details of the partnership's formation, but said it should be up and running by mid October.
Michael "Mickey" Magher, now runs JJ Kenny's dollar bond desk, a JJ Kenny spokeswoman said.
